name: Best Helper of 2025
description:
This paint was created especially for the most
active, diligent and hardworking helpers of 2025. These are those members of the helpers
community who dedicated their whole year in helping other tankers and maintaining the order in the {GAME_NAME} community. The owners of this paint are a shining example of dedication and devotion, and they are truly worthy of the title "Best Helper of the Year".
interestingFacts: Author of this paint is Seraphina.
The paint first appeared in the game on December, 25, 2025.
